snippet.title: Grave Seasons - Official Demo Release Date Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Console Release Date Trailer for Grave Seasons, a narrative farming simulation game developed by Perfect Garbage. Players will embark on a farming adventure with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge. Grave Seasons is launching on August 14 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam), with a demo launching on June 15 for PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
